checks.detail: Geon side fully pinned (reuse F228): M_rem=0.93060 M_Pl (exact-algebraic, F190/F107); entropy-conserved yield coeff fixed => beta needed for Omega=0.12: 1e+04 g: 6.62e-15, 1e+06 g: 6.62e-12, 1e+08 g: 6.62e-09. The ONLY unpinned quantity is beta(M_form).

Press-Schechter inversion of the F228 beta band -> required RMS amplitude at the PBH scale sigma ~ 0.0584..0.0792 (delta_c=0.45). This is the amplitude the primordial spectrum must have at the small (PBH-formation) scale to source Omega_DM.

Scale-invariant (n_s=1) spectrum at the CMB amplitude sigma_CMB=4.583e-05: x=delta_c/(sqrt2 sigma_CMB)=6944 => beta_HZ~10^(-2.094e+07), giving Omega_DM h^2 ~ 10^(-2.094e+07) <<< 0.12. The tuning-free spectrum UNDER-produces by ~2.09e+07 orders. A scale-invariant primordial spectrum CANNOT make the geon relic.

Power ~ sigma^2 => the small-scale spectrum must be boosted by (sigma_req/sigma_CMB)^2 ~ 1.62e+06..2.99e+06 above the CMB amplitude. Spread over ~18 decades in k that is a blue tilt Delta(n_s-1) ~ 0.35 (or a localized spike). This boost is an INFLATON-POTENTIAL input, not a geon-sector quantity.

beta(sigma)=1/2 erfc(delta_c/sqrt2 sigma) is strictly monotone in sigma (log10 beta grid ['-441.8', '-50.4', '-18.9', '-8.0', '-4.1', '-1.9', '-1.4']) with no interior fixed point => there is NO dynamically selected critical/attractor beta. beta tracks sigma one-for-one, so deriving beta REQUIRES deriving the small-scale sigma (the spectrum).

Searched findings/ and ca-simulation/: inflaton/preheating/primordial-spectrum findings=NONE, modules=NONE. The model has NO inflaton finding and NO primordial-power-spectrum machinery (ca_cosmology.py starts at the hot Big Bang). So sigma(k) at the PBH scale is an EXTERNAL input.

VERDICT: Omega_DM h^2=0.12 is NOT derivable from the model as it stands. The abundance is inherited one-for-one from beta(M_form), which Press-Schechter ties to the small-scale primordial amplitude sigma(k_PBH). That amplitude must be ~2e6x the CMB value (S4); the only tuning-free spectrum under-produces by ~2e7 orders (S3); there is no attractor (S5); and the model has no inflaton/spectrum sector to fix it (S6). So abundance is a FREE COSMOLOGICAL INITIAL CONDITION, isolated to a single external number -- extending F228's 'beta is the residual' to 'beta is provably a free input, and here is exactly why.'
